content.summary: Codere Online ( (CDRO) ) has provided an update. Codere Online Luxembourg, S.A. announced the resignation of Marcum LLP as its independent registered public accounting firm due to IT control deficiencies and insufficient internal controls. The company is actively seeking a new auditor and is making efforts to complete its financial filings to regain compliance with Nasdaq requirements, highlighting ongoing challenges in meeting regulatory expectations and maintaining operational integrity.
